name: Slithering Strike
body:
You leave your foes in awe with your superior movement in combat. Enemies can only watch in astonishment as you dance around them, readying the strike that’ll end their lives!

Prerequisite(s): 4th-level Fighter

Benefit: Whenever you successfully strike an opponent, as a free action, you may move 5 feet in any direction that you choose, including away from your opponent, without invoking an attack of opportunity.
